lines.t: I was running in circles, losing my breath
Fighting my shadows, held down by the weight in my chest
But you stepped in, lightening through the rain
Yeah, who's your why? Every fear bowed down at your name
When the night tries to pull me under
Your voice breaks in like rolling thunder
Break through my life
Your power crashing in like thunder
Lift me to life
Your love tearing every wall asunder
Yahshua shine
Let the darkness fall beneath your name
I'm alive
When your light breaks through again
Your light breaks through again
Break through your lies, your lies
Break through your lies, your lies
When my heart shakes
And the ground beneath me breaks
You steady my soul with every move that you make
You turn fear to fire, ashes into gold
You're the strength in my bones, the hope I hold
Every chain falls at your presence
Every breath is filled with your essence
Break through my light
Your power crashing in like thunder
Lift me to life
Your love tearing every wall asunder
You should wash out
Let the darkness fall beneath your name
I'm alive
All alive when your light breaks through again
Your light breaks through again
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Thanks for watching!
